About

Built for industry.
Ready from day one.

I'm a mechanical engineer with an M.Sc. in Mechatronics & Automation from ZHAW, based in Winterthur. My background covers the full product development cycle — from early-stage CAD concepts through tolerance analysis, simulation, physical testing, and handover to series production.

I've worked across medical devices, IoT hardware, and industrial systems — always in environments where precision matters and mistakes have real consequences. I'm comfortable on the design side and equally at home working closely with production teams, suppliers, and technicians on the shop floor.

What drives me is seeing a component go from a sketch to something that works reliably in the field. I'm looking for an industrial engineering role in Switzerland where I can contribute immediately and grow technically.
